exposure: Fertility-sparing surgery (unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, peritoneal biopsy) for epithelial ovarian carcinoma
outcome: Delivery of a healthy baby at term
cohort: A 24-year-old nulligravida woman diagnosed with FIGO stage IA, grade I epithelial ovarian carcinoma.
finding: A woman who underwent fertility-sparing surgery for well-differentiated epithelial ovarian carcinoma successfully conceived and delivered a healthy baby at term 1.5 years post-surgery.
